question: Why does the roadmap recommend hybrid retrieval instead of relying only on dense vector search?
evidence: Dense vectors miss exact keyword/entity/acronym matches (e.g., product codes, legal clause numbers); BM25 catches those. Hybrid gets both semantic and lexical recall.
alt_evidence: Hybrid search combining dense + sparse via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)
reference_answer: Dense search can miss exact keyword, entity, acronym, product-code, or legal-clause matches. BM25 catches lexical matches, so combining dense and sparse retrieval improves semantic and lexical recall.
